references.observed: Dry oblique overview identifies the long north rockfill wedge, white DSİ lettering, diagonal berm road, penstock fan and shore powerhouse. A separate pale concrete section carries six narrow crest gates and a three-lane lower spillway with a broad stepped toe.
Downstream discharge view makes the three main spillway lanes, two distinct outlet mouths between powerhouse and spillway, stepped lower lip, and adjacent terraces and electrical yard visible.
